scrolls: Casting a scroll uses no Magicka, and anyone can use one whatever their magic skill.
Scrolls give no skill experience, except the Scroll of Blizzard (Destruction).
Each scroll works once. You can't move while casting, and a hit interrupts the cast without using the scroll up.
Spell merchants sell a random selection. Many more are fixed loot, often tucked among rolls of paper.
spiders: Dragonborn only. Spider scrolls are thrown, not cast, use no Magicka, and work once each.
Made at the Imbuing Chamber in White Ridge Barrow on Solstheim, from albino spider pods.
Albino spider pods come from a respawning albino spider egg just south of Bloodskal Barrow, near a shrine to Kynareth.
Elemental spider recipes that include a flawless gem make six scrolls instead of three. Up to nine spiders can be out at once.
